scenario.title: 截稿前的倒數
scenario.context: 趕截稿時一直在講「到週五前我們就會完成…」「等客戶看到的時候我們已經改了三版」。這種「到未來某個時間點前已經完成」的說法，就是未來完成式（will have + p.p.）。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: OK team, it's crunch time. Where are we?
lines.zh: 好各位，關鍵時刻到了。我們進度如何？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: By tonight, I'll have finished the main visuals. The social media versions will be done by tomorrow noon.
lines.zh: 今晚前我會完成主視覺，社群版本明天中午前會好。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: The website is 80 percent done. By Thursday, we'll have tested it on every device.
lines.zh: 網站完成 80%。週四前我們會在所有裝置上測過。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The printer says they won't have delivered them until Friday morning.
lines.zh: 印刷廠說他們要到週五早上才能送到。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Friday morning? The event is Friday afternoon. That's going down to the wire.
lines.zh: 週五早上？活動是週五下午，這也太趕了。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I know. I'll call them again and see if they can do Thursday.
lines.zh: 我知道，我再打給他們看能不能週四送。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: You're still here? It's almost midnight.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah, I'm burning the midnight oil. By the time I leave, I'll have redone this layout four times.
lines.zh: 對，我在熬夜趕工。等我離開的時候，這個版面我會已經改了四次。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Please don't pull an all-nighter. You'll be useless tomorrow.
lines.zh: 拜託別通宵，你明天會廢掉。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know. I'll leave by one. By this time next week, it'll all be over.
lines.zh: 我知道，我一點前會走。下週這個時候就全部結束了。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: And we'll have survived another launch.
lines.zh: 我們又撐過一次上線了。

chinglish.wrong: Before Friday I will finish it.
chinglish.right: I'll have it done by Friday. / I'll finish it by Friday.
chinglish.why: 截止期限用 by。before Friday 表示「週五以前」，週五當天不算，意思略有不同。

chinglish.wrong: Until Friday, I will have finished.
chinglish.right: By Friday, I will have finished.
chinglish.why: until 是「持續到」，完成的期限要用 by。這是台灣人很常搞混的一組。

chinglish.wrong: I will stay up all night to do it.
chinglish.right: I'm going to pull an all-nighter.
chinglish.why: 文法沒錯，但慣用說法更自然。

chinglish.wrong: The deadline is too close to die.
chinglish.why: 「死線快逼死我」直翻不通，英文說 The deadline is killing me。

grammar.title: 未來完成式＋by
grammar.oneLiner: will have + p.p.：到未來某個時間點之前，某件事已經完成。常搭配 by + 時間。
whenToUse: 到未來某時已完成：By Friday, I'll have finished the designs.
常用時間詞：by tomorrow, by next week, by the time…, by then。
否定：won't have + p.p.：They won't have delivered it by Thursday.
by the time + 現在式, will have + p.p.：By the time you arrive, we'll have started.
口語常用簡單的 will + V 或 will be done：It'll be done by Friday.
by（截止）vs until（持續）：I'll finish by 5. / I'll work until 5.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用「到…之前就會…了」表達未來完成，動詞不變。英文則需要 will have + p.p.。另外，台灣人很常混用 by 和 until，因為中文都說「到…為止」。記住：by 是「最晚在這之前」，until 是「一直持續到這個時間」。

examples.correct: By next month, I'll have worked here for a year.
I'll be in the office until 7.
By the time the client wakes up, we'll have sent the files.
examples.incorrect: By the time the client will wake up, …
examples.note: by the time 後面用現在式。

examples.correct: They won't have finished printing by Thursday.

quiz.question: By Friday, we ___ all the designs.
quiz.explanation: 到未來某時已完成：will have + p.p.。

quiz.question: I'll be working ___ midnight tonight. (持續到)
By the time you ___, we'll have started the meeting.
quiz.explanation: by the time 後面用現在式。

quiz.question: By next June, I ___ have lived in Taipei for ten years.

slang.usage: 截止日前工作量最大、壓力最大的時期。

examples.en: It's crunch time. No more coffee breaks.
examples.zh: 最後衝刺了，不能再喝咖啡休息了。

examples.en: Everyone works late during crunch time.

slang.meaning: 拖到最後一刻、非常驚險
slang.usage: 源自賽馬的終點線。go down to the wire = 到最後一刻才見分曉或完成。

examples.en: The project went down to the wire, but we made it.
examples.zh: 案子拖到最後一刻，但我們做到了。

examples.en: The game went down to the wire.
examples.zh: 比賽打到最後一秒才分勝負。

slang.usage: 整晚不睡來工作或讀書。

examples.en: I pulled an all-nighter to finish the pitch deck.
examples.zh: 我熬通宵把提案簡報做完。

examples.en: I'm too old to pull all-nighters now.
examples.zh: 我年紀太大，現在熬不了通宵了。

slang.usage: 源自以前點油燈工作到深夜。比 pull an all-nighter 文雅，不一定是整夜。

risk.note: 有點書面，職場和寫作都適合。

examples.en: She's been burning the midnight oil to finish her thesis.
We burned the midnight oil all week before the launch.
examples.zh: 上線前整週我們都挑燈夜戰。

review.question: I'll follow ___ with the printer tomorrow morning.
Your manager says, "You might want to start earlier next time." She means:
review.explanation: 複習第 54 單元：委婉句其實是要求。

review.question: The printer will ___ deliver on Friday morning.
This project took ___ time as the last one.
review.explanation: 複習第 48 單元：twice as much。

review.question: If we ___ tonight, we'll be ready.
The client ___ us redo the whole thing.
review.explanation: 複習第 24 單元：make + 人 + 原形。
